response.sql: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_paid) AS overall_avg FROM rental_totals) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.total_paid) AS total_payment_sum, AVG(rt.total_paid - o.overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM rental_totals rt CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rt.total_paid > o.overall_avg GROUP BY rt.store_id ORDER BY rt.store_id

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is taken over rentals that have at least one linked payment (rentals with no payments are not counted as zero), since the request says to count only payments linked to a rental.
A rental's store is the store_id of its inventory copy, reached through rental.inventory_id.
